newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Influential U.S. Senators Alfonse D'Amato and Christopher Smith have sent a letter to President Bill Clinton asking that Romania be included in the first wave of NATO expansion.
* President Emil Constantinescu has started a three-day visit to Greece and met his opposite number Costis Stephanopoulos.
The Romanian delegation also includes Foreign Minister Adrian Severin, Reform Minister Ulm Spineanu and the head of the State Ownership Fund, Sorin Dimitriu.
Constantinescu meets Prime Minister Costas Simitis on Friday.
* The opposition launched a motion in the parliament's lower Chamber of Deputies to denounce the government's policy of cutting jobs in the farming, education, health and justice sectors.
The motion was signed by 75 deputies from the Party of Social Democracy, the National Unity Party and the Greater Romania Party and is scheduled for debate on May 27.
* Bucharest opened an international consumer goods fair with 430 foreign companies from 17 countries exhibiting.
